amendment_trigger.admission_problem: The existential any-yaw rule added 20/19,200 and 35/19,200 false admissions, all ambiguous fragments. A fragment can match the full hull at one convenient extreme yaw.
amendment_trigger.admission_amendment: Require at least half of the complete deterministic yaw grid to pass every unchanged Stage-06 criterion. A majority-support rule is fixed here before the V2 outcome is read; it introduces no fitted confidence, pixel or shape threshold.
amendment_trigger.evaluator_problem: V1 compared measurement-to-truth error with P+R. P+R instead describes the prior-to-measurement innovation, making the V1 upper-containment failure an evaluator error.
amendment_trigger.evaluator_amendment: R2C is scored on measurement-to-truth residuals; P+R2C is scored on prior-to-measurement innovations.

data_boundary.authorized_population: All 9,600 Stage-06 commissioning_fit camera opportunities, including detector misses and non-positive references.
data_boundary.independence_statement: The already-opened final audit is not independent validation of this adapter and is prohibited from selection.
data_boundary.audit_role: Commissioning-only deterministic robustness diagnostic; perturbation draws are not independent replicates.

adapter.name: majority-supported nuisance-yaw hull admission
adapter.fallback_trigger: Only after the point-estimate yaw fails the locked Stage-06 hull gate.
adapter.sample_rule: Uniform deterministic odd grid including the mean and both endpoints of the marginal yaw interval.
adapter.candidate_rule: At least half of all grid points must pass every unchanged Stage-06 hull criterion.
adapter.selection_rule: After majority support, choose the passing candidate minimizing squared log width-ratio plus squared log height-ratio; tie-break by absolute yaw displacement.
adapter.position_rule: Do not search x/y; retain timestamp-matched belief x/y.
adapter.measurement_rule: Use selected nuisance yaw only for analytic equivalent-position correction and frozen Stage-07 features.
adapter.heading_update: Position only; never update or publish heading.

reporting: Complete opportunity/reference/admission/refusal/recovery counts by regime, camera and spatial block.
Precision, reference-positive recall and added false admissions.
Frozen Stage-07 corrected median, RMS, p90, p95, maximum and count above 0.25 m.
R2C measurement-residual containment and Pxy+R2C innovation containment.
prohibitions: Do not change detector confidence or Stage-06 hull thresholds.
Do not fit/refit Stage-07 correction or covariance.
Do not use final-audit data for adapter selection.
Do not call perturbation rows independent samples or campaign replicates.
Do not launch the final campaign unless V2 audit and a fresh end-to-end preflight pass.
